requested_claim: For every elliptic curve E over Q, E is modular in any of the six equivalent senses on pages 845-846 of the primary BCDT paper.
missing_conclusion_interface: an elliptic-curve L-series tied to E/Q
a normalized weight-two eigenform at level N(E)
an equality relating that eigenform L-series to the elliptic-curve L-series
or an equivalent l-adic representation or modular-parametrization predicate together with checked equivalence transports
rejected_substitutions: a Modular predicate supplied as a variable or typeclass assumption
existence of an arbitrary analytic ModularForm unrelated to E
Theorem B on irreducible mod-5 representations
minimal_import_result: The pinned Weierstrass import elaborates the domain boundary, but no pinned import was found that supplies the missing relation required for the BCDT conclusion. Consequently there is no truthful exact target or expression hash to record.

mutation_tests.reason: Mutation testing requires a canonical elaborated proposition; manufacturing a predicate merely to obtain syntax would weaken the exact-statement gate.

retry_condition: A pinned Lean 4 dependency must provide, or a later implementation must faithfully define from existing mathematical primitives, one of the paper's six modularity conditions for E/Q and the required checked transports. The resulting universal proposition must then elaborate and undergo domain, hypothesis, binder-scope, and boundary mutation tests.
status_boundary: This artifact records a failed statement gate. It is not a Lean statement, proof, anchor audit, accepted receipt, audit-completion claim, or theorem-completion claim.
